answers.reason: As head of a faculty representing it towards the central leadership, the dean takes part in the central university senate.
The budget planning round allocates funds to faculties, and the dean represents the faculty towards the university leadership.
The dean leads the faculty and holds a higher office than the faculty's appointment committee, permitting participation.
The description explicitly states that the dean chairs the faculty council.
The study commission advises the faculty council, and as a higher office holder in the faculty, the dean may take part in bodies below their level.
The examination board is a faculty-level body below the dean's office, so the dean is permitted to take part.
This round awards the faculty's internal grants, falling under the faculty level where the dean holds the highest office.
This working group operates within the faculty below the dean's level, and those with higher office may take part in bodies below their level.
Choosing equipment for a teaching laboratory is a decision below the dean's level within the faculty, permitting the dean to take part.
Planning the orientation week for new students is a lower-level faculty activity in which the dean, holding a higher office, may participate.
